title: Chapter 2: Finally, the Stage of the Otome Game, the Royal Capital 2
content: "To your blood, there is little difference between the lower and upper classes."
"Huh?"
"That said, do you wish to enter the upper class?"
It's not like I desperately want to get in or anything.
It's just that—
"There are people I need to protect."
My fiancée, who has been tossed around by fate.
"This year's academy will be tumultuous. Many destinies will intertwine, becoming complex, sometimes going mad, and some will be driven to madness."
After throwing out those cryptic words, Volzeia asked again.
"Even so, do you wish to step into the upper class?"
"I have no intention of running away."
"Very well."
Volzeia, who had been staring intently into my eyes, softened his demeanor a bit and announced,
"I will allow you to enter the upper class by the authority of the academy director."
"But, Director!"
At that moment, the examiner, who had just woken up, panicked upon hearing Volzeia's words.

"He was born in Discarded Land!? And his fiancée, the former duchess, is causing a tremendous incident!! If we allow him to transfer to the upper class, it will surely disturb the peace of the academy!!"
"Fool!!"
A single shout.
"Yikes!"
As Volzeia's voice rang out, magical power surged from his body like a waterfall, causing the examiner to cower in fear, paralyzed by the pressure.
"Who are you within the grounds of this academy? If you are a noble, leave at once."
"...I am a teacher."
Sweat dripped from the examiner's face as he looked down.
"Then behave like a teacher. If you think problems will arise, show the way to prevent them; guide them so they never happen again."
"Y-yes... I apologize..."
"Now return. Arrange for the wall to be repaired."
The examiner fled the gymnasium as if escaping.
After watching him leave, I bowed my head again to Volzeia.
"Thank you very much."

"Good. In the name of the sage, I will not condone discrimination based on student status, but I will not get involved in problems arising from other factors. If you misunderstand how to conduct yourself and become disliked, that is your own responsibility."
Though he said it in a complicated way, it essentially meant that if I were to be disliked due to my daily behavior, aside from discrimination, I would have to deal with it myself.
It seems like this phrase could easily be misunderstood, so wouldn’t it be better to simply say, "Let’s act with consideration for others’ feelings"?
"I will keep that in mind. In Brave Territory, those who take advantage of their strength will die... but when I feel the need to wield it, I will not hold back."
That is the essence of Brave.
"Do as you wish."
With just that, Volzeia left the gymnasium.
It was a rather cryptic exchange, but to summarize, I suppose it meant to enjoy my school life?
Well, as long as I can have a fun school life with Alicia, I have no intention of causing unnecessary trouble.
"Lagna Vel Brave, there was something I forgot to mention."
The academy director returned briskly. Just when I thought he had left in a cool manner.
"Considering the circumstances, I have made an exception to allow you to use that house, but you are still students. Be mindful of maintaining a healthy relationship."
"Ah, yes."
That was the line delivered with a sharp gaze and a serious tone.
Understood, Director. I have no intention of becoming a beast of Brave.
"I'm home!"
When I returned home after successfully passing, Alicia, dressed in her uniform, welcomed me.
She looked so lovely and beautiful in her uniform that I almost mistook the entrance for heaven.
Though she wore black tights instead of bare legs, well, that was still a perfect score!
"Lagna! Are you okay? Did they say anything strange?"
"I'm fine, I'm fine."
She rushed over to me, looking like an overly protective mother.
"The students here, including myself, face particularly severe discrimination due to parental influence, and many teachers condone it."
"That's true."
Alicia, who had been raised in this academy and was labeled as the prime example of a discrimination supporter by her entourage, was understandably worried.
Regarding Alicia's situation, I think it's just a matter of distinction, so it can't be helped.
Bullying is wrong, but even within the academy, it’s unacceptable for a commoner to flirt with the crown prince while disregarding his fiancée.
Even I wouldn’t be allowed to marry a common adventurer, you know?
The incident with Alicia early in the school year was a tragic event born from such obvious circumstances.
Why doesn’t the crown prince understand that the people around him are overreacting?
Logically speaking, using another woman to break up with his current girlfriend is the act of a scumbag, even in modern Japan.
"My practical magic exam passed with flying colors. Due to various circumstances, I was exempted from the academic subjects."
I said this to reassure the worried Alicia.
"Knowing you, that sounds plausible. What happened?"
"There was an examiner who really wanted to fail me, and after I beat him up, the academy director passed me."
"...What did you actually do?"
She looked at me with a puzzled expression, but I was just telling the truth.
"Ah, the academy director is a good person."
"That's true. If it were the old me, I might have found him bothersome, but now I can see he is a person of integrity who puts students first."
Without the academy director, things would have gotten much more complicated.
I was glad that everything wrapped up nicely, as I didn't want to cause a commotion that would worry Alicia.
"By the way, I've been curious for a while, but what kind of magic do you use, Lagna?"
"Nothing special. I can do everything, but I’m particularly good at barriers."
Even those barriers are simple magic that can be easily used without any aptitude.
One of the holy attributes, it creates a transparent wall that can block anything.
Just like the protective barrier that covers the royal capital.

"Just being good at barriers doesn't mean the academy, the largest in the magic powerhouse, will let you off the hook for academics, right? And to draw with a dragon, honestly, that’s hard to believe. Are you really just good at barriers?"
"Well, it might be different from what everyone thinks."
I don’t usually teach my preferred magic to others, but I decided to share it with Alicia.
While sipping the coffee she brewed for me, I created a rectangular barrier in front of me.
"Normal barriers look like this, right?"
"Yes. The fact that you can create it without chanting is surprising, but... for now, I’ll accept it as Lagna being Lagna, so please continue."
Alicia, smiling while twitching her lips, made me realize just how much she had adapted to the Brave Family.
But saying she accepts it just because I’m Lagna feels a bit disrespectful to me, doesn’t it? Well, whatever.
"I can create various shapes, not just walls, when I don't chant."
"Eh?"
Normally, you would need a lengthy chant like, "In the name of the Holy Goddess, I shall create a protective wall," which would only result in a wall.
Without chanting, I can create not just rectangular walls but also dome-shaped or cylindrical ones, among other shapes.
To prove this, I formed a cup-shaped barrier and poured coffee from the cup I was holding into it.
"Whoa, whoa!"
Alicia, panicking at the sight of the black liquid floating in the air, looked adorable.
"Barriers can do this...?"
"Think about it; the protective barrier covering the royal capital is a good example."
"Ah, that’s true."
When I said that, Alicia seemed convinced.
That barrier is indeed a splendid one, and it is dome-shaped.
"There are also differences between normal barriers and the royal capital's barrier, right?"
"...Hmm, it can choose what to let through?"
"Exactly."
As expected of a talented girl, she catches on quickly.
"Advanced barriers can freely determine not only their shape but also what they let through and what they repel."
The royal capital's barrier allows people to pass but not magic.
It’s absurd that magic from the outside is repelled while magic from the inside out is allowed to pass.
Covering the entire royal capital requires an enormous amount of magical power, but I have no idea how they manage that.
"So, can you do something like the royal capital's barrier?"
"I can do even more detailed things."
Unlike the massive barrier of the royal capital, the barriers I use are limited in range, making them cost-effective.
"Like this... and..."
I scooped up the coffee that was in the cup-shaped barrier and returned it to the original cup.
"This is definitely a class that would pass in practical exams..."
"If you ask if it's versatile, it's close to that, but there are things I can't do."
I can't separate the sugar and milk from the coffee in Alicia's cup, which is filled with sugar and milk.
I could separate things like silver coins mixed in with gold coins or bugs stuck to grass, but once they are mixed together, I can't separate them.
"So, how do you draw with a dragon?"
Alicia leaned in closer.
There are complex factors involved beyond just what to let through or not, but before I could explain, my stomach growled.
Grrrrrrr~. By the way, that was Alicia's stomach.
"Le-let's have dinner! I can cook now, so leave it to me!"
I watched her run to the kitchen with her face flushed.
That raised a question in my mind.
Why was Alicia in her uniform?
Classes start tomorrow, and unlike me, Alicia had no exams, so she didn’t need to wear her uniform... but well, it was a feast for the eyes, so I guess it doesn’t matter.
She'll wear it tomorrow, and this must be a pre-check for size and other things.
Classes began the next day, and as expected, I received many gazes from the students.
"Oh, look, it's the damaged goods from the duel... back already?"
"Serves her right, forcing her entourage to bully her. Truly disgraceful."
"At this point, she won't be able to marry anyone, right? She was beautiful, though."
"But if she’s fallen in status, they could make her a concubine, right?"
"She’s damaged goods, right? I heard she was married off to Discarded Land?"
I was met with disdainful gazes from the daughters of other families and pitying, scrutinizing looks from the sons.
"Lagna, it's fine to ignore them. I'm okay."
Alicia was trying to act brave, but her hand holding her bag was slightly tense.
"It’s okay, I’m here."
"Hehe, that’s right. If you swore to the dragon, I can relax. I was unconscious, though."
When I showed her my pinky, she smiled a little. I was glad it got through to her.
If Alicia can endure, I won’t make any conspicuous moves either.
However, if anyone directs clear malice toward her, I will not hold back.
"Whoa, she suddenly foamed at the mouth and fainted! Is she okay!?"
"Quick, call the nurse!"
As I walked through the commotion with a nonchalant expression, I felt a light jab to the back of my head from Alicia.
"Stop it."
"Hey, I didn’t do anything..."
I had only directed killing intent at the guy who made the concubine remark, but I never expected him to faint.
The inner territories are weak, huh? They’re definitely living comfortably within the protective barriers.
After that, we headed to our respective classrooms.
I couldn't push through to be in the same class, so Alicia and I ended up in different classrooms.
Even though she had been absent, she still had her original seat, so it couldn't be helped.
I was somewhat worried about her being in the same classroom as her former fiancé, but the teachers here were no different from those in my previous life, so I thought it would be fine.
It would be awkward for both of us, and as long as we didn't get too involved, things would remain peaceful.
However, there was a concern, or rather, an unexpected factor in my classroom.
In my mob class, there was a seat for the game's protagonist, Mariana Ocean.
That makes sense; events typically unfold outside of the classroom.
In places where the teacher's gaze doesn't reach, the protagonist, who suffers severe discrimination, is approached by the prince and other target characters who resolve the issues.
If we were in the same class, it would be like having the protagonist's knights around all the time, and such events would be unlikely to occur.
Now, the protagonist, Mariana, is a beautiful girl with dazzling blonde hair and stunning blue eyes, praised by the prince with, "Mariana, your eyes are as beautiful as this cloudless blue sky."
Why did she get compared to the sky when her name has "ocean" in it?
I felt a simple question arise from my memories of playing the game as I looked at her back sitting diagonally in front of me.
"Everyone, the magic most adeptly used by the sage is the four elements, but can anyone tell me which magic was used most frequently among them?"
"Yes!"
"Mariana Ocean, please go ahead."
"It’s non-attribute! The sage who mastered magic reached the pinnacle of nothingness!"
"Correct. To not be swayed by the trick question, you truly are a child of the sage."
Mariana, who raised her hand first and answered the teacher's question, was praised and sat back down, satisfied, while adjusting her thick glasses with a smile.
Whether it was a miscalculation or not, the protagonist in this classroom was vastly different from the image I had in my memory.
...Is that really the protagonist? No, is it okay for that to be the protagonist?
I was shocked by her studious demeanor, which was far from the romantic academy life one would expect.
If I were a prince, would I find her attractive?
Her thick glasses were so strong that they ruined her beautiful eyes.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HJK9G2i.jpeg
So, it must be the gap, the gap moe!
Perhaps when she takes off her glasses, an unparalleled beauty is revealed, and the target characters are captivated by that contrast.
"Oh no, my glasses!"
It seemed her thick glasses were quite worn out, and after adjusting them multiple times, the frame broke and fell.
Seeing her hurriedly pick up her glasses, I was once again shocked.
Mariana, without her glasses, had eyes that looked like the number "3."
"W-what should I do? They were expensive... Can I still use them if I tie them with a string...?"
I thought she was a character only seen in a gag manga.
This is not a setting that should be allowed in an otome game world.
"She broke her glasses again..."
"How many times is this? It’s like every three days!"
"She’s so pitiful; someone should buy her a new pair."
"I heard she refused; she said she can't accept them."
I could hear voices from the mob nobles sitting around her.
A protagonist who breaks her glasses every three days is pushing the limits of character traits, and as I was left dumbfounded, I noticed a strange feeling.
The protagonist, Mariana, is a commoner and a close friend of the target character who has a high status in this country, so she is treated like a pariah by the surrounding nobles.
As the story progresses, she becomes friends with nobles who do not condone bullying, but for some reason, she was gaining sympathy from those around her.
While she was treated like a pariah, it was not out of jealousy or contempt, but rather pity.
What on earth is going on? I felt like banging my head on the desk.
"Oh no, there’s a scratch on the lens... If I had known, I should have asked to be moved to the front for my eyesight..."
"Hey, do you want to switch seats? It’s fine with me."
A kind-looking female student offered Mariana a suggestion with a wry smile.
"N-no, I'm fine! Yes, I'm fine!"
Mariana shook her head vigorously, bowing.
"Thank you for your kindness! I can manage on my own! Please don’t worry about me!"
"Ah, if you say so..."
As she shook her head excessively, her thick glasses flew off.
The kind student who showed her compassion looked extremely confused.
"Mariana Ocean, pick up your glasses. And for the next seat change, your seat will be right in front of the teacher's desk. Is that acceptable?"
"Y-yes! I’m sorry! I’m sorry!"
N-no way.
The more I looked, the more she deviated from the image of the protagonist I had in my memory.
Alicia, who did you fight against?
And the noble idiot behind me who kept tearing up small pieces of paper and throwing them at my head, I’ve remembered your face and name!
"Hey, did you hear? Someone in the next classroom got seriously injured."
"I know, they fell and broke all their fingers, right? That sounds painful."
In the afternoon, I was staring out at the courtyard from the roof of the school.
The protagonist I discovered in class was, for some reason, not acting like a protagonist and was living her school life inconspicuously, like a commoner.
In a way, she stood out tremendously.
So, who was Alicia's duel opponent? If I don't find that out, our peace will remain a distant dream.
"I can't ask Alicia about it."
I didn't want to dig up her trauma, so I decided to follow the events I remembered from the game.
The duration of enrollment at this academy is three years, but the game depicted the first year after enrollment in much more detail.
The encounter events with each target character usually happen early after enrollment, and once the flag with the crown prince is raised, the engagement cancellation event occurs.
Then, while overcoming the obstacles set by the villainous noblewoman with the help of the target characters, the bonds deepen in a classic storyline.
Starting with an engagement cancellation event is quite a bold development, and knowing how Alicia gets swept up in it makes it hard to say anything.
What can be inferred from this is that the protagonist is clearly raising flags with the crown prince.
"Otherwise, the engagement cancellation event wouldn’t happen."
As I muttered that, I organized the information in my memory.
As the events progressed smoothly, the protagonist and the crown prince often shared lunch not in the cafeteria but under the shade of a tree in the courtyard.

For commoners, the noble cafeteria is uncomfortable, and the protagonist would bring her lunch and eat alone in the courtyard, where the crown prince, feeling sorry for her, would come and share a meal.

For some reason, the courtyard lunch event became a regular occurrence, and if the other characters' favorability was high, other characters besides the crown prince would also gather, forming a decent-sized group.
After clearing the game, you could see an illustration of everyone happily spending time in the courtyard, titled "Lunch Reverse Harem 01."
That’s quite a casual title.
Given that three months have passed since the story began, the chances of having lunch in the courtyard are high.

That's why, if I could spot the prince, who is the number one target character in this country, Edward Gran Aetherdam, from the roof with a good view, I would naturally know who is in the protagonist position.
Alicia's former fiancé, the prince, is exactly what one would call a classic prince.
Why? Because he’s easy to manipulate.

The backstory of how the protagonist and the prince met goes back to before enrollment, when they met in the densely packed castle town while sneaking out and he learned about the commoner lifestyle far removed from the royal family.
With that premise, their reunion at the academy is truly fateful, and it easily made the crown prince fall for her. The setup practically screams to pursue the prince.

In the dungeon part, during the demon invasion part, and even in battles with other countries, the prince's base abilities are so high that clearing is easy, making it seem like the developers are telling you to go for him first.
"I'm sorry to keep you waiting!"
"I just got here too, Your Highness."

"Hahaha, to keep a lady waiting is a disgrace for royalty, right? Also, when we’re here eating your lunch, I’d like you to call me Edward instead of Your Highness. I want to be called by my name, not my title."
Here he comes, the handsome prince.
The blonde prince appeared in the courtyard, delivering a line that would make anyone's teeth rot.
"That’s too much, I can’t..."
"Patricia, you used to call me Edward so casually."
"That’s because I didn’t know you were royalty..."
"Please, Patricia. I want to be just Edward in front of you, not the crown prince."
"W-well... Edward... that’s embarrassing..."
In front of me unfolded a pink space, and the woman sitting directly across from Edward, while having blonde hair and blue eyes, was someone who bore no resemblance to the protagonist.
Patricia... who is she?
No matter how much I searched my memory, I couldn’t find a student by that name in the game.
[img]https://imgur.com/a/1ZNZSn7
Upon closer inspection, her roots were black, clearly dyed.
In other words, someone who is not Mariana has taken her place and is occupying the protagonist position.
"Hey, Edward, don’t forget we’re here!"
"That’s right. You can’t just sneak off."
"Your Highness, it’s more delicious to eat lunch together, right?"
"To think the courtyard has become our cafeteria, Patricia really knows how to capture all our stomachs."
"But it’s more delicious to eat here than in the cafeteria. Eating the lunch Patricia made with everyone is several times better. It’s strange."
"Sounds fun, right? Can I join in too, hehe?"
A group of handsome men gathered around the prince and Patricia.
"Ahaha, everyone is here today too! Don’t worry, I always make extra just in case, so let’s eat together!"
"Seriously, you guys... Patricia must have it tough, so can’t you hold back a little?"
"It’s fine, Edward, I’m totally okay."
"Patricia, you’re such a natural, that’s what makes you wonderful."
This is definitely Reverse Harem 01!
Occupying the protagonist position, they are forming Reverse Harem 01!
I realized this with astonishment.
This Patricia is likely another reincarnator, just like me.
"Does that girl want to die...?"
In otome games, there’s a reverse harem ending where all flags are raised, and the story ends with everyone being friendly.
However, is it really possible for that to happen in reality?
No, it’s impossible.

It’s not uncommon for nobles to take concubines, and achieving a harem is possible, but for a young commoner girl to create a reverse harem among high-ranking nobles like the royal family or dukes is impossible.
Mariana’s humble demeanor in class might seem a bit excessive, but the relationship between commoners and nobles is generally like that, so it’s not wrong.
"Seriously...?"
Typically, handsome men in line to inherit their families are often engaged from a young age, and while having Edward alone might still be manageable, having multiple is genuinely risky.
They might overlook it now because they’re students, but it wouldn’t be surprising if they mysteriously died after graduation.
Fantasy is only allowed in the game world. No, is this even a game?
Mariana was fine because during her time at the academy, it was discovered that she possessed the power of a saint, allowing her to attain a status high enough to marry into royalty.
As for Patricia, a commoner girl who doesn’t exist in my memory.
"Well, I guess I can leave her be."
Even if she is indeed another reincarnator, I have no intention of helping her.
After all, the imposter is not a saint.
After the revelation of the saint, there won’t be any events that would humiliate Alicia, so I’ll be grateful for that at least.
I don’t plan to get involved with this reverse harem group in the future, nor do I need to pay attention to the handsome men other than Edward, but there is one person I should be concerned about.
His name is Jelasis Gran Ignite.
He is the second son of the Ignite family, as per the information I received from the Magic Bug magician.
With fiery crimson hair and jet-black eyes.
Typically, red-haired characters are depicted as assertive and aggressive, but in this otome game, he was portrayed in the opposite manner.
"Here’s a line that says, ‘It’s more delicious to eat here than in the cafeteria. Eating the lunch Patricia made with everyone is several times better. It’s strange.’"

He is the one who said that, and even while everyone is chatting around him, while eating, and when spoken to, his facial muscles don’t move at all, making it impossible to tell what he’s thinking—a silent, mysterious character.
Uh, if I remember correctly, he’s the illegitimate child of the Ignite family?
The eldest son of the Ignite family already exists, and he has been raised as a backup.
In the Jelasis route, the protagonist becomes concerned about him, who always steps back a bit from the group, and actively begins to talk to him, leading to various events.

His family is burdened with various issues behind the scenes, and the protagonist, with the help of everyone, guides him toward resolution, gradually bringing back his smile in a story that is quite deep and substantial.

Due to his setting of rarely smiling, there’s only an illustration of him smiling at the very end of the story; if you clear it, he has a pure and innocent smile, but if you fail, he has a terrifying smile twisted by jealousy.
It seems many players intentionally failed to see that special ending...
Given that there’s a fact that the Ignite family has been targeting him, it seems likely that if I keep brushing off the flames, I’ll inevitably get involved.
I’m not sure how the imposter is handling that route, but it’s clear that they are processing all the flags.

If there are other handsome men around to help, then the puzzle pieces to deal with the complex family issues are in place, so if I just kick away all the incoming threats, my enemies will likely disappear on their own.
"I should be somewhat concerned, but for now, I’ll leave it."
What I seek is Alicia’s peace and the avoidance of her downfall, as well as dealing with the turmoil that will inevitably come at the end of the story.
For that, the question is what to do with Mariana Ocean, who should be in the position of the saint... ugh, it’s troublesome.
If the imposter hadn’t taken her position, the saint awakening event would have occurred smoothly, but does she even realize what she’s done?
Currently, Alicia isn’t on the villain route, so she won’t become the source of disaster, but if something distorts, there will inevitably be repercussions somewhere.
I intend to take responsibility for the turmoil in Brave Territory, which will be engulfed by the army of monsters, but what will happen with everything else?
As the story progresses, the barrier covering the royal capital will be destroyed.
In the game, it was destroyed by Alicia, who had turned into a demon.
I suspect it was due to someone’s manipulation, and I assume it’s possible to destroy it even without Alicia.
What will be needed at that time is the power of the saint.
As it stands, it’s confirmed that the saint awakening event won’t come, but what on earth is she planning to do?
"Patricia’s cooking is truly wonderful!"
"It gives you strength, right? It’s strange."
"I’ve been cooking since I was little... ehehe, I’m so happy..."
"I’d like to eat it every day, Patricia."
"I’ll come here every day to eat it, Your Highness!"
"Hahaha, you should read the room sometimes, you guys?"
Sigh, how carefree.
As I watched the Reverse Harem 01 group, I muttered in disbelief.
